label: petal appendage
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0009032 (petal)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is an outgrowth of a petal (PO:0009032), usually on its adaxial surface or at the junction of claw and limb, such as a scale, crest or ligule, as in Sapindaceae, Caryophyllaceae and Polygalaceae.
reason: A real structure described across many floras, with no PO class. It parallels the existing FLOPO connective appendage and faucal appendage. The 2026-11-13 review rejected bare 'appendage' only because it lacked the organ. Propose to PO upstream.

label: fruit body
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0009001 (fruit)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the main, seed-bearing portion of a fruit (PO:0009001), exclusive of any beak, wing, stipe or other appendage.
reason: Its length and width deliberately leave out the beak or wing, so mapping it to fruit would change the measurement. It is the counterpart of the existing fruit beak (FLOPO_0986139), and the wording is used across Brassicaceae, Fabaceae, Apiaceae and Cyperaceae. Propose to PO upstream.
